correctness.rationale: Under A>=0 the cubic g=x(1-x)(A+mx) has unique maximum c, giving exact [0,1] invariance iff r<=1/g(c). Upper fixed-point multiplier 1+x q'/q is strictly decreasing, so -1 is crossed once at u; local normal form has a2²+a3>0, giving a generic supercritical flip. Shape-normalized ratio R(s)=g(c)/q(u) is strictly increasing: the displayed rational derivative is positive after reducing to a positive quartic over u∈[2/3,3/4]. Endpoints are 3/4 and 64/81. Independently solved roots and checked strict ratio increase on 101 shapes, but universal claim rests on rational inequalities, not the sample.
